# Uxhan Forge

Uxhan Forge is an independent software, mobile application, and game development studio co-founded by Muhammad Umer Farooq and Muhammad Burhan Yousaf.

## Co-founders

- Muhammad Umer Farooq — Co-Founder — https://uxhanforge.vercel.app/founders/muhammad-umer-farooq
- Muhammad Burhan Yousaf — Co-Founder — https://uxhanforge.vercel.app/founders/muhammad-burhan-yousaf

## Products

- Taqwa Habit — Islamic habit-tracking app, available on Google Play — https://uxhanforge.vercel.app/apps/taqwa-habit — https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.taqwahabit.app
- UXBLOX — upcoming block-placement puzzle game — https://uxhanforge.vercel.app/apps/uxblox
- RailBop — upcoming train-track puzzle game — https://uxhanforge.vercel.app/apps/railbop
